Postmatric Scholarship for SCST Students DME - Eligibility

Caste | ST students

Family annual income | Rs. 2.5 lakhs to <=Rs. 10 lakhs

Course Type | Students studying MBBS, BDS, MDS, MD & MS

College Type | All

College Seat Type | All except Management quota

Promotion status | Promoted to current academic year

Any other condition | Student must upload parent's salary certificate and Non-practising certificate (for PG students)
